manifest_yaml:
name: hello-world-api
version: 1.0.0
description: A simple Hello World API service
category: demo
tags:
  - demo
  - api
author:
  name: Test Developer
  email: test@example.com
  did: did:duxnet:test123
api:
  openapi: 3.0.0
  base_path: /api/v1
  endpoints:
    - path: /hello
      method: GET
      description: Returns a hello world message
container:
  image: nginx:latest
  ports:
    - 8080
  env:
    PORT: "8080"
    MESSAGE: Hello from DuxNet!
  resources:
    memory_mb: 256
    cpu_cores: 0.5
pricing:
  model: free
  per_request: 0
  monthly_cap: 1000
sla:
  uptime_guarantee: 99.0
  response_time_ms: 100
